env_namespace.OPENAI_API_KEY: ollama (DOCUMENTED NON-SECRET DUMMY; the actual SDK raises Missing credentials with no key even against Ollama; never a real credential; an explicitly-set operator key is kept as-is; C installers use the same literal constant)
env_namespace.OPENBOT_TOOL_URL: FULL callback endpoint, default http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/agent-tools/call (posted verbatim, never extended)

prohibited: keyless OPENAI_API_KEY with only a base URL (config_check fails: the SDK refuses keyless construction)
verifier-invented credentials (verify_ollama_model_object uses only the passed env)

reachability.container_run: 127.0.0.1 inside the image is the CONTAINER, never the host. Use in_container=True (-> http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 on Docker Desktop) or an explicit Linux host-gateway/--add-host endpoint that Ollama actually binds. A host-127 URL must never be tested as container reachability.

proven: tests/test_upstream_entrypoint.py::test_ollama_route_boots_real_model_path_end_to_end (real vendored main._model + AG-UI POST + enforcing callback, all personal auth removed, loopback fixtures only)
